title: Act: Implement state model and pure runtime systems
summary: Create game package config, types, state, conditions, inventory, events, dialogue and scene engine
description: Create the game TypeScript package under backend/game and the pure runtime modules. Context: backend/game does not exist. Desired behavior: types define content and state shapes; systems operate immutably. Expected result: modules importable by loader and tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given the package, when tsc --noEmit runs, then it compiles with strict mode.
Given any system function, when called, then the input state is not mutated.
technical_constraints: package.json scripts: test = vitest run, typecheck = tsc --noEmit

steps.action: Create package.json with type module, scripts test='vitest run' and typecheck='tsc --noEmit', dependency yaml, devDependencies typescript and vitest; also create tsconfig.json (strict true, module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, target ES2022, include src and tests) and vitest.config.ts using defineConfig with test.include ['tests/**/*.test.ts'].
steps.expected: npm install in backend/game succeeds and vitest/tsc binaries exist.

steps.action: Create tsconfig.json with compilerOptions strict true, module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, target ES2022, noEmit true, types [] and include ['src','tests'].
Create vitest.config.ts exporting default defineConfig({test:{include:['tests/**/*.test.ts']}}) imported from 'vitest/config'.
steps.code:
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';
export default defineConfig({ test: { include: ['tests/**/*.test.ts'] } });
steps.expected: vitest discovers only files under tests/.

steps.symbol: new: Condition, GameEvent, ActionDef, ObjectDef, DialogueNode, SceneDef, WorldDef, GameState

steps.action: Implement createInitialState(world:WorldDef,scene:SceneDef):GameState with currentScene=world.startScene, empty collections, activeDialogue=scene.openingDialogue??null; setFlag(state,flag,value) returning {...state,flags:{...state.flags,[flag]:value}}; addHistory(state,line) returning a new state with line appended.
steps.expected: Functions return new objects; inputs unchanged.

steps.action: evaluateCondition(state,c) returns state.flags[c.flag]===(c.equals??true) for flag conditions and state.inventory.includes(c.hasItem) for hasItem conditions; evaluateAll(state,conds?) returns true when conds is undefined/empty or every condition passes.
addItem returns state with item appended only if absent; removeItem returns state with item filtered out; hasItem returns state.inventory.includes(item).

applyEvent switches on event.type: set_flag->setFlag, add_item->addItem, remove_item->removeItem, goto_scene->{...state,currentScene:event.scene,activeDialogue:null} with history 'Went to <scene>', say->addHistory '<character>: <text>', show_text->addHistory text, discover->add object id to discoveredObjects once; applyEvents reduces a list in order.

getActiveNode(state,scene) returns the DialogueNode matching state.activeDialogue or undefined; chooseOption(state,scene,index) applies the choice's events via applyEvents, appends history of the choice text, and sets activeDialogue to choice.next??null; returns state unchanged when node or index is invalid.
steps.expected: Choice advances dialogue and records history.

steps.action: getSceneView(state,scene) returns objects each with only the actions whose conditions pass, plus an open:boolean computed from openWhenFlag in state.flags; performAction(state,scene,objectId,actionId) finds the action, returns state unchanged if object/action missing or evaluateAll fails, otherwise returns applyEvents(state,action.events).
